description: The requested session and evidence completeness.

watermark.description: Ingest is complete through this instant for every signal read.

complete.description: True only when the requested window ends at or before the watermark.

examined.description: Records examined, or null when unknown.

matched.description: Matching records, or null when the read was cut short.

returned.description: Items returned, or null when unknown.

truncated.description: True when a row limit, page limit or byte budget omitted matching items.

freshness.description: Evidence completeness for the requested window. Unknown counts remain null.

snapshot_id.description: Opaque, project-scoped identity of an immutable telemetry snapshot.

next_cursor.description:
Opaque pagination cursor. Pass the `next_cursor` of one page to receive the
next page of the same query. Its content is not part of the contract and
must not be parsed or built by a client.

tool_use_id.description: Claude Code's id of one tool call, tool_use_id on its events.

command.description: tool_parameters.full_command of a shell call; absent for other tools.

error_type.description: error_type of a failed call, such as ShellError.

finished_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp preserved exactly as text, including fractional precision and offset. Leap seconds are not supported. Execution windows additionally require an instant representable by the telemetry store.

subagent_id.description: The subagent that made the call (agent_id); absent for the session's own agent.

trace_id.description: Unique trace identifier (32 lowercase hex characters)

items.description: One tool call, from its tool_result event. Claude Code sends no exit code: success covers the whole command line.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls in the order they finished.

commit_sha.description: A full git commit id: 40 lowercase hex digits, or 64 in a SHA-256 repository.

branch.description: vcs.ref.head.name when HEAD was a branch; absent on a detached HEAD.

tool_use_id.description: Claude Code's id of one tool call, tool_use_id on its events.

committed_at.description: When the git commit call finished; git's own commit time is not sent.

items.description: A commit the session made, from the tool_result of its git commit call.

commits.description: Commits the session made, oldest first.

commit_sha.description: A full git commit id: 40 lowercase hex digits, or 64 in a SHA-256 repository.

session_id.description: The session that ran it, which for a contradicting run can be another one.

tool_use_id.description: Claude Code's id of one tool call, tool_use_id on its events.

finished_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp preserved exactly as text, including fractional precision and offset. Leap seconds are not supported. Execution windows additionally require an instant representable by the telemetry store.

items.description: A gate run: a foreground shell call whose whole command line is ./eng/build.sh Check or ./eng/test.sh, with arguments but without a pipe, &&, ; or ||, so its success stands for exit code 0.

evidence.description: The gate runs at this commit that decide the verdict, oldest first; empty when none does.

items.description: A claim that the gate passes at one commit, for each commit the session made or ran the gate at. verified: this session ran the gate at the commit and it succeeded; contradicted: a later gate run at the commit failed; unverified: otherwise.

session_id.description: Unique session identifier: URL-safe characters, at least one, at most 128, not only dots. The same rule the SDK enforces on the baggage header.

agent_name.description: The gen_ai.agent.name resource attribute, when the session sets one.

models.description: Models of the session's api_request events, sorted.

efforts.description: Effort levels of the session's api_request events, sorted.

cost_usd_micros.description: Sum of cost_usd_micros over the session's api_request events.

failed_tool_call_count.description: tool_result events whose success is false.

first_seen.description: RFC 3339 timestamp preserved exactly as text, including fractional precision and offset. Leap seconds are not supported. Execution windows additionally require an instant representable by the telemetry store.

last_seen.description: RFC 3339 timestamp preserved exactly as text, including fractional precision and offset. Leap seconds are not supported. Execution windows additionally require an instant representable by the telemetry store.

session.description: A field projection of SessionDetail; omitted members were not requested.
